title: Caro!
subtitle: The bill, the military tattoo, Musetta carried off in triumph, Alcindoro left to pay, La bohème, Act 2

passages.label: Caro! The bill, and empty pockets (Allegro alla marcia, B flat major)
La Ritirata! the crowd runs to see; Musetta has the friends' bill added to hers
Paga il signor! E dove s'è seduto ritrovi il mio saluto
Giunge la ritirata! The friends plan their escape
Lesti! Ecco il tambur maggior: the tattoo marches through
Viva Musetta! Carried off in triumph; Alcindoro and the bill (to the end of Act 2)

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)
licences.author: Luigi Illica (1857–1919) and Giuseppe Giacosa (1847–1906)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 145-166 (from the Allegro alla marcia, page 145 system 2, to the end of Act 2, 129 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. The print's eight chorus groups are gathered here into four staves by voice (every note and syllable kept, each group named where it comes in on a shared staff; groups singing together are written as separate voices on the staff). The offstage drums' separate staff is not included. Tempo from the printed metronome mark (Allegro alla marcia ♩ = 132); the closing allarg. e sostenendo is a value chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
